outcome_evidence: The oven is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the upper door handle and then draws the door outward; separation from the oven body is visible by frames 101–112 in image. The door remains visibly open through frame 192, with its outward-projecting handle and angled glass also visible in wrist_image. The opening is partial rather than fully lowered, but the task does not specify an opening angle. No failed acquisition, damage, or unintended object displacement is established.
